endorsements.quote: Cancer educators should consider incorporating AI literacy into educational programs.

Patients should learn that AI systems can generate inaccurate information, that responses may not reflect the latest clinical guidelines, and that AI-generated content should not replace consultation with qualified healthcare professionals.

unlisted_practices: Encourage patients to verify AI-generated cancer information through trusted sources.
Encourage patients to discuss information obtained from AI platforms with their healthcare teams.
Teach patients how AI systems work, why hallucinations occur, and how algorithmic biases can influence generated responses.
Treat accountability for inaccurate AI-generated health information as a shared responsibility among developers, healthcare organizations, healthcare professionals, and patients.
AI developers should design safer and more transparent systems that minimize misinformation, bias, and harm.

screen.reason: This is a commentary discussing the ethical and governance responsibilities among stakeholders (patients, clinicians, organizations, developers) when generative AI provides inaccurate cancer information.
